scope: All 14 task families registered in sim_protocol; idealised and real-reference energy tasks are variants, not extra task families.
meaning_of_both: Two separately named runs: Genesis native RigidSolver and Genesis with IPCCoupler. It does not mean enabling two independent rigid contact responses on the same pair.

software.release_policy: Latest published releases verified against GitHub releases and PyPI on 2026-11-14; fixed versions, not moving main.

native_track.name: Genesis native rigid
native_track.B1: Literal RigidSolver numerical defaults of the pinned release; set the declared physical scene and actual integration interval only. Record resolved defaults and importer changes.

ipc_track.name: Genesis + IPC
ipc_track.contact_backend: libuipc CUDA; rigid objects represented as ABD
ipc_track.B1: Pinned Genesis IPCCouplerOptions and resolved libuipc defaults. Do not silently tune d_hat, friction regularization, resistance, or coupling strength before B1.
ipc_track.fixed_base_joint_route: external_articulation, subject to joint and anchor-geometry probes
ipc_track.driven_body_route: Explicit libuipc input adapter or validated two_way_soft_constraint coupling; never assume a Genesis-side setter reaches IPC
ipc_track.force_and_velocity_telemetry: Read and validate IPC-side state/contact results. Genesis-side IPC-only velocity is zeroed by the v1.4.6 bridge and is not valid physical velocity telemetry.
ipc_track.contact_ownership: One contact owner per pair. Confirm coupled pairs are excluded from the native rigid collider.
ipc_track.precision: Record both Genesis precision and IPC internal precision; do not assume they are identical.

shared_requirements: Same physical manifest, seeds, geometry representation, mass/inertia, effective pair friction, gravity and actual substep dt. Importing the same file is insufficient evidence.

Rigid material friction and IPC coup_friction are separate inputs. The pinned IPC bridge combines entity coup_friction geometrically; set and audit the effective contact-pair value instead of inheriting its default.
Rebuild IPC scenes for mass/geometry grid cells. Native batched rigid-info randomization is rejected by the pinned bridge; R=20 batches may share topology and physical cell parameters.
A scene with fixed-base joints must preserve its joint axes, limits and passive forces; free ABD props are not a substitute for an articulated model.
Validate initial velocity, external force and prescribed trajectory routing before any candidate is scored.
IPC initial-intersection and thickness checks must pass. Do not silently lift, separate or project a body. Any changed start is a new common physical revision for every engine.
Match collision surfaces; an IPC triangle mesh must not be compared to a native convex approximation without declaring and auditing the representation difference.
Keep exactly the approved task metrics and thresholds. Do not invent a new aggregate ranking metric.
Each named track gets its own declared B<=5 budget and frozen winner. Selecting the better of both tracks is not a B=5 result.
Do not count a valid environment smoke test as a complete task implementation or an audited B1/B5/generalizability result.

tasks.ipc_setup: Three separate dynamic boxes and a fixed ground. Force-driven pushed body needs validated force transfer; other boxes may be IPC-only props.
prerequisites: Verify F/m in free space with the identical force API
Verify effective pair mu and normal resultants
Check centred-stack initial touching/overlap feasibility

tasks.ipc_setup: Preserve pad x/z slide joints, constant inward force and z-PD trajectory. Cube remains a dynamic rigid body; the external weight load must reach IPC. Whole-scene gravity remains zero.
prerequisites: Joint/actuation and external cube-load routing
IPC force readout supports the existing 5% preload gate
Initial touching plus pitch perturbations must not create inadmissible intersections

tasks.ipc_setup: Three IPC-only dynamic plates and one fixed ground. Match circular collision representation, mass/inertia and common mu=0.8.
prerequisites: Initial plane/plate and plate/plate distances
d_hat relative to 0.5-mm thin plate cases
Independent IPC interface load and overlap readout

tasks.ipc_setup: GAUGE ball mesh as a dynamic IPC-only body, fixed floor at the registered height. Use the same release state and 30-Hz sampling clock.
prerequisites: Release velocity perturbations reach the IPC state
Mass/inertia and floor offset match
Keep apex/trajectory loss and real references unchanged

tasks.ipc_setup: One dynamic rigid cube and a fixed floor. Initialise both linear velocity and body/world-frame-consistent angular velocity in the IPC world.
prerequisites: Linear and angular velocity routing
Explicit inertia matches the existing reconstruction
Retain the 24-symmetry orientation metric and disjoint real trajectory IDs

tasks.ipc_setup: Dynamic cube and fixed floor with the same recorded start state; no reset into a settled pose. Measure settling from IPC-side motion and support force.
prerequisites: Initial state and velocity routing
IPC load readout passes the existing force-health checks
Do not interpret the bridge's zero velocity getter as settling

tasks.ipc_setup: Dynamic cube; static board for static-board cells, validated driven/kinematic board for moving-board cells. Match the board mesh pose and prescribed pose/velocity trace.
prerequisites: Board trajectory actually reaches the IPC world
Tracking error is measured rather than assumed zero
The same material/friction pairing and sample times are used

tasks.ipc_setup: Dynamic object and fixed table; pusher follows the same registered xy trajectory using validated slide-joint or IPC kinematic input. Preserve separate table/object and pusher/object pair friction.
prerequisites: Pusher tracking within the declared tolerance
Object explicit inertia and pair friction match
IPC pusher wrench is validated before reporting wrench errors

tasks.ipc_setup: Five fixed-anchor revolute mechanisms, using external_articulation or an explicitly validated joint bridge. Do not replace the suspended balls with free IPC-only bodies.
prerequisites: Massless/collision-free anchor representation is accepted without adding physical contacts
Hinge position/axis and length remain exact
Read actual joint/body velocity for the existing energy validity gate

tasks.ipc_setup: No IPC contact is present in the declared scene. Use native rigid joint dynamics. IPC may later be a separately labelled joint-coupling control, not a required contact benchmark.
prerequisites: Keep GAUGE geometry, release state, damping assumptions and the approved real-reference metric definition explicit

tasks.ipc_setup: Passive dynamic peg and fixed socket using the same audited bore geometry. This is a strong IPC contact-mechanism comparison once initial geometry and thickness are feasible.
prerequisites: Use a declared socket revision; v6 draft is not silently promoted
Preserve the bore rather than convexifying it shut
Barrier thickness/d_hat versus tight clearance and initial contact
Retain the selected revision's success/penetration definitions

tasks.ipc_setup: A future IPC track would require a validated floating-base joint/torque bridge, potentially two_way_soft_constraint on foot links. The pinned external_articulation setup rejects non-fixed bases; passive IPC-only props cannot represent Cassie.
prerequisites: Native model/state/torque mapping and spring/damping import
Floating-base and contact-force transfer validation
Do not substitute compliant link coupling without reporting it
Keep physical fidelity limited to the released 50-ms window

tasks.ipc_setup: First preserve the underactuated tendon/joint mechanism in native rigid. An IPC contact track is conditional on a faithful actuation and coupling implementation; independent freely moving fingers are not the same task.
prerequisites: Tendon/underactuation import and command mapping
Shared object/initial state/reference registration
Do not claim a real-data replay while the required task registration is absent

tasks.regime: driven supports with multiple rigid objects
tasks.ipc_setup: Use the existing two moving fork supports, shallow rigid plate and three rigid spherical tomatoes. Validate support trajectory transfer; plate/tomatoes may be IPC-only props. This remains the declared simulation-only surrogate.
prerequisites: Driven support pose/velocity routing
Non-convex plate collision surface and initial contacts
Do not turn tomatoes into FEM or claim actual GLIDE hardware reproduction
